summary.text: One of the fifty daughters of Danaus by the Naiad nymph Polyxo — by lot the bride of Lixus son of Egyptus when the twelve sons of Aegyptus by Caliadne married the Danaids at Argos.

story.text: Apollodorus lists Cleodore eighth among the daughters of Danaus borne on Polyxo. When the twelve sons of Egyptus by Caliadne cast lots for the Polyxo maidens, Lixus drew Cleodore. On the wedding night she received her father's dagger and, like her sisters, slew her bridegroom.
